note: Both sets perform very poorly at extracting data from the plots. They both hallucinate non-existent entities (like FFA-W3-1, FFA-W3-2, FFA-W3-210) and consistently misread the values from the graphs (e.g., claiming lift coefficients are 0.0 at an angle of attack of 0 degrees, when the graphs show them around 0.5). Because both sets contain a vast majority of incorrect or hallucinated claims, they are equally bad.
